facts.fact: The selected code imports the already prepared annotation object.
Note is used to select named single/control classes; Gene2 supplies anchor-single labels and Gene1 library-single labels in the displayed aggregation.
MyNote is used for combination/singleton category selection, with constituent labels distinguished by position.
The code concatenates two guide-label fields of an anot object. This alone does not bind them to WGE IDs, sequences, the acquired matrix, or actual measured support.
Some anot processing substitutes guide-class labels for blank target labels. The projection does not establish that the acquired matrix was created by those statements.

projection_scope: 156 exact-symbol source lines only, not a complete script audit or repository-wide absence proof. Literal example selectors are exposed documentary context and cannot choose a scientific subset.
